# Aki Wellness

> Recovery conditioning and sports massage for skiers and snowboarders in Niseko, Hokkaido, Japan, delivered in English by a licensed physiotherapist. Aki Irikawa, a Japan licensed physiotherapist (理学療法士) with over 16 years of experience, treats guests at their hotel, condominium, chalet or home. Open every day of the year, 12:00 to 22:00 JST. English and Japanese spoken.

## Treatments and prices (JPY)
- Dry massage (no oil, through light clothing): 60 min ¥25,000, 90 min ¥32,000
- Oil massage: 60 min ¥28,000, 90 min ¥34,000
- Sports massage and physio treatment: 60 min ¥30,000, 90 min ¥36,000

## Booking
- Book online with a ¥10,000 deposit (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay); balance paid on the day
- Chalet hosts and concierges can book for guests on WhatsApp
- No Japanese needed; everything is handled in English
- WhatsApp or phone: +81 90 7482 1882
- LINE ID: aki-a-iri
- Aki confirms the time by message after booking

## Areas served
Hirafu, Upper Hirafu, Hanazono, Annupuri, Niseko Village, Moiwa, Kutchan town. Other locations on request.

## Cancellation
- Same day: 100% of treatment price
- Day before: 50%
- Two or more days before: deposit refunded

## Credentials
- Licensed Physical Therapist, Japan (理学療法士)
- Japanese Red Cross CPR certification
